input.contents:
# StreamForge

Premium cinematic streaming UI built with React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, Framer Motion, and React Router.

## Features

- Home hub with hero carousel, trending, movies, TV, anime, continue watching, and recommendations
- Debounced search with filters (type, genre, year, rating)
- Details pages with cast, similar titles, and recommendations
- VidCore-powered player with Primary / Backup server switching
- Favorites, watch history, and continue watching (localStorage)
- PWA, SEO meta tags, error boundaries, skeleton loaders, lazy routes

## Setup

```bash
npm install
cp .env.example .env
```

Add a free [TMDB API key](https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api) to `.env` for rich metadata. Without it, the app falls back to Cinemeta (Stremio) catalogs.

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Playback (VidCore)

Streams are embedded from [vidcore.net](https://vidcore.net):

- Movies: `https://vidcore.net/movie/{imdbOrTmdbId}`
- TV: `https://vidcore.net/tv/{id}` with optional `season` / `episode`
- Server switch via `?server=primary` or `?server=backup`

## Routes

| Path | Page |
|------|------|
| `/` | Home |
| `/search` | Search |
| `/details/:id` | Details |
| `/watch/:id` | Player |
| `/favorites` | Favorites |
| `/history` | History |

## Keyboard shortcuts (player)

- `F` — fullscreen
- `R` — reload stream
- `B` — switch to backup server

content.text:
**StreamForge** is scaffolded in your workspace with the full stack, routing, VidCore playback, and localStorage library features.

## Quick start

```bash
cd "C:\Users\Lorenzo Rapattoni\.cursor\projects\empty-window"
npm install
cp .env.example .env
```

Add a free [TMDB API key](https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api) to `.env` for rich metadata (posters, cast, recommendations). Without it, the app falls back to **Cinemeta** catalogs.

```bash
npm run dev
```

## What’s included

| Area | Implementation |
|------|----------------|
| **Routes** | `/`, `/search`, `/details/:id`, `/watch/:id`, `/favorites`, `/history` |
| **Design** | Dark cinematic UI, green glow, glass cards, Framer Motion, mobile-first |
| **State** | Zustand + localStorage for favorites, history, continue watching, playback prefs |
| **Metadata** | `services/media.ts`, `services/search.ts` (TMDB + Cinemeta fallback) |
| **Player** | VidCore iframe embed with provider adapter architecture |
| **UX** | Skeletons, lazy routes, infinite scroll (search), SEO (`react-helmet-async`), PWA, error boundary |

## VidCore provider architecture

```
src/providers/
  Provider.ts          # interface
  vidcore.ts           # URL builder (movie/tv, server, startAt)
  primary.ts           # Primary · HD · Fast
  backup.ts            # Backup · Ultra
  providerManager.ts   # switchProvider(), fallback, localStorage
```

Playback URLs follow [vidcore.net](https://vidcore.net) docs:

- Movies: `https://vidcore.net/movie/{imdbOrTmdbId}?server=primary|backup&autoPlay=true`
- TV: `https://vidcore.net/tv/{id}` (+ season/episode when set)

The watch UI shows **⚡ SERVERS** with green glow on the active server and the message: *“Slow or unavailable? Switch servers below.”* Keyboard shortcuts on the player: **F** fullscreen, **R** reload, **B** backup server.

## Project structure

Matches your spec: `components/{layout,player,media,ui}`, `pages`, `hooks`, `services`, `providers`, `store`, `types`, `utils`.

## Notes

1. **No auth/payments** — only localStorage for library and settings, as requested.
2. **Details/watch URLs** use `?type=movie|tv|anime` for correct metadata and VidCore path (`movie` vs `tv`).
3. Run `npm install` locally (dependencies are not committed). After that, `npm run build` should produce a production bundle.

If you want, I can add TV season/episode pickers on the details page or wire a default TMDB key for zero-config demos.

content.text:
StreamForge got a **7reels-style UI pass** and a **much stronger search experience**. Restart the dev server to see it:

```bat
npm run dev
```

### UI (7reels-inspired)
- **Outfit** font, darker surfaces, mesh background, green accent glow
- **Full-width cinematic hero** — large rating pill, year/type badges, genre chips, Watch / More Info
- **Editor’s Choices** genre strip (links into filtered search)
- **Richer posters** — play overlay on hover, rating badge, metadata line (`8.4 · 2019 · TV`)
- **Section headers** with labels (“Popular · This Week”) and View all links
- **Sticky header** with quick search + **mobile bottom nav**
- **Footer** trust strip (free, no sign-up, etc.)
- **Details page** layout closer to 7reels (backdrop, genre links → search)

### Search (major upgrade)
- **Large sticky search bar** with poster **suggestions dropdown**
- **Tabs**: All · Movies · TV · Anime
- **Chip filters** for rating + year (no more plain dropdowns)
- **Recent searches** + **trending queries** when empty
- **Genre browse** without typing (`/search?genre=Action`)
- **Paginated TMDB results** with infinite scroll
- **List-style result cards** (poster, rating, overview, Watch / Info)
- **URL sync** (`?q=`, `type=`, `genre=`, `rating=`)

### Try it
- Home → scroll genre chips → opens filtered catalog  
- Search → type a title → pick from suggestions or press Enter  
- Empty search → browse trending terms + popular grid  

If anything looks off after refresh, say which page and we can tune it further.
